name: auth-api-cross-project-impact
description: Three-project Jira, Notion, and Bitbucket story for entity resolution, fact comparison, breaking-change impact, mismatch detection, and truth-maintained resolution.

expected: Auth Service provides Auth API v1
MCP Gateway consumes Auth API v1 and calls POST /v1/auth
Argo Orchestrator consumes Auth API v1 and calls POST /v1/auth
AUTH-900 is classified as a proposed breaking API change
MCP Gateway and Argo Orchestrator appear in the blast radius
The existing v1 dependency remains live until migration or effective removal
Jira and Notion claim MCP completed migration to v2
Neuron raises a documentation/code mismatch and does not silently close the v1 dependency
MCP leaves the Auth API v1 blast radius
